comment: All candidates shared AdamW and Δ=0.0256, making low-progress architecture rules decisive. K1006 favored the three-LayerNorm group over the one-LayerNorm group; K1008 supported residual ReLU D first and LeakyReLU C over SiLU E at equal LN count. A versus B was the least strongly supported comparison: both had three LNs and normalized final blocks. A’s contiguous late normalization was a plausible tie-break, but K1022 does not directly distinguish them because their final LN positions match. The gold order supports the existing preferences without establishing a new general rule.
